scope: CAD sampled gravity screen. Worst gravity direction optimized separately for each joint, not all maxima at one configuration.
assumptions: No fatigue, stiffness, printed-layer material data or motor acceleration simulation.
Only modeled steel-envelope fastener masses included; harness and unmodeled arm flange fasteners omitted.
Neutral configuration first moment only, not a full joint-range gravity search.
Use measured printed part and purchased frame masses before motor decisions.
Elbow rotation omitted because gravity orientation is optimized and rotation about its own axis preserves the moment norm.
No inertia torque, rotor/gear dynamics, friction, cable force, backlash or thermal derating.
70percent static fraction is a project screening target, not a manufacturer rating or approval.
Arm motor bodies are nominal cylinders, flange geometry and structure are not finalized.
